query:
SELECT g.exame_nome AS "exame!", count(*) AS "atendimentos!" FROM recepcao.atendimento a JOIN agenda.agendamento g ON g.id = a.agendamento_id
           WHERE a.unidade_id = $1 AND g.inicio >= $2 AND g.inicio < $3 AND a.situacao <> 'cancelado'
           GROUP BY g.exame_nome ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 30
